title: Dashboard Visual Maturity Rubric
purpose: Separate technical dashboard compliance from visual product quality so a route cannot be called done only because source markers pass.

visualTiers.label: Raw functional surface
visualTiers.meaning: The route renders and may be usable, but visual hierarchy, spacing, interaction polish, and product fit are not yet approved.

visualTiers.label: Readable organized surface
visualTiers.meaning: One-shell and readable, with no catastrophic overflow, but still visually generic or uneven.

visualTiers.label: Consistent system surface
visualTiers.meaning: Uses shared shell, spacing, cards, tables, forms, and states consistently, but still needs product-grade hierarchy and polish.

visualTiers.label: Product-grade cockpit
visualTiers.meaning: Modern, task-oriented, polished, responsive, interaction-complete, and visually aligned with approved reference families.

visualTiers.label: Reference-grade pattern leader
visualTiers.meaning: Approved as a reusable visual reference for future dashboards and component-kit evolution.

checks: collapsed and expanded states are polished
project identity is visible but not bulky
primary task is obvious in first viewport
non-actionable status is collapsed or moved out of the way
horizontal and vertical spacing use the same rhythm
cards do not touch or crowd
headers, badges, controls, and body content align inside the card
cards are not dropped behind old content
card density matches the content type
secondary copy is useful and not generic
helper text moves into approved help affordances when needed
tables sit inside a proper surface
wide data uses horizontal scroll inside the table surface only
visual style is modern and not hand-drawn
drawers have clear titles, actions, and persistence behavior
desktop, tablet, mobile, and collapsed-sidebar states are captured
fixed regions do not hide content
the surface supports a real workflow
critical actions are clickable and verified
state persists or clearly explains why not
the user can resume work later

required: component or pattern promoted to dashboard kit
